GmailMessageHeader.description: A single header of a Gmail message part.

GmailMessageHeaderOutput.description:
One RFC 5322 header of a Gmail message.

Headers are a list rather than a map, a message being free to repeat a
name and their order being meaningful.

GmailMessagePartBody.description: The body of a single MIME part of a Gmail message.

attachmentId.description:
The id of an external attachment, retrievable via a separate
`users.messages.attachments.get` request.

data.description:
The body data as a base64url-encoded string; absent when the
data lives in an external attachment.

size.description: The number of bytes of the message part data.

body.description:
The body of the part, which may be empty for container MIME
parts.

filename.description:
The filename of the attachment; empty when the part is not an
attachment.

headers.description: The headers of the part, such as To, From or Subject.

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the part.

partId.description: The immutable id of the message part.

parts.description: The child parts of a container MIME part.

GmailThreadMessageOutput.description:
One message of a Gmail thread.

The thread id is left out, since it is the id of the enclosing
[`GmailThreadGetOutput`].

description:
Gmail thread and its messages, rendered as an indented list or,
under `--json`, as a structured object instead of a wrapped human
string.
title: GmailThreadGetOutput
